title: Check yourself: Coverage, report structure, rendering by content type, and the practice

questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. A synthesis agent holds sales numbers for five companies over four quarters, a short account of a takeover and the usage caps of a vendor's service. How should it present them?

options.text: Figures as bullets, the story as a grid, the quotas as running text
options.says: Ruled out because when a news story is turned into a table, "it loses its causes and its sequence".

options.text: Figures as a grid, the story as running text, the quotas as bullets
options.says: The guide renders "financial data as tables, news as prose, technical findings as structured lists".

options.text: Everything as one grid, with a column naming the kind of content
options.says: Ruled out because the guide warns against "converting everything to a uniform format".

options.text: Everything as running text, with the figures spelled out in sentences
options.says: Ruled out because "a table of figures turned into sentences cannot be compared".

questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. A draft report mixes claims that three independent sources confirm with one where two reports disagree. A reviewer says readers cannot tell the two kinds apart. Which change fits the guide's advice?

options.text: Place the oldest results first and the newest last within each part
options.says: Ruled out because ordering by age leaves the two kinds mixed, whereas the page sets "the settled facts first and the open questions in a place of their own".

options.text: Add a confidence value produced by the model after each sentence of the report
options.says: Ruled out because a value the model produced about its own finding "carries the same blind spot as the finding", and it leaves the two kinds mixed.

options.text: Remove the disputed claims until the sources can be reconciled by someone
options.says: Ruled out because removal takes away the open questions "each with what is needed to judge it".

options.text: Give the established and the contested results sections of their own
options.says: The guide asks for "explicit sections distinguishing well-established findings from contested ones".
